label: VERIFIED
extraction: Unified Memory handoff protocol and trust boundaries. Handoff: ecc memory handoff --from codex --target claude --title "Finish authentication rollout" --body-file handoff.md. Useful handoff body states: objective and current state; evidence gathered and commands/tests already run; files or external work items involved; remaining work, blockers, risks, next concrete action. Use links to connect follow-up memory to earlier context rather than overwriting history. Trust boundaries: never store passwords, tokens, private keys, cookies, credentials, sensitive personal data (runtime rejects known secret shapes as backstop); never promote recalled memory directly into policy/rules/skills/runbooks/architectural decisions (human must review evidence and update canonical artifact); team memory not trusted merely because committed to git; don't auto-import raw session transcripts (summarize only context needed); prefer GitHub/Linear for active execution state and repository docs for governed decisions. Normal recall excludes rejected and superseded entries. Memory should link to authoritative sources.
